opening.argument: The solicitation makes participation contingent on purchasing mining equipment or a mining pool, including a $3,500 hardware pool tied to mining several Bitcoins. It then uses projected returns—claiming that such a pool could yield $100,000 to $150,000—alongside tiered pools and compounded-earnings language to encourage participation. A slide displays four priced mining-pool options with commission and repurchase percentages. The disclaimer that "we cannot make any future guarantees" appears within that same solicitation; it qualifies the pitch but does not remove its promotion of substantial projected returns.
